title: Intraday futures on 1-minute data (Topstep/Lucid-compatible, flat every day): news-minute continuation detected from price, RTH gap fade
registered: 2026-10-20, before the Databento 1-minute data arrived and before any Dukascopy minute-data Gen124 number
data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m front contract (.v.0) for ES and NQ, 2018-01..2026-09 (research_data/databento/{ES,NQ}_1m.parquet); returns only within one instrument_id. Replication on Dukascopy US500/US100 5-minute CFD data
already_rejected_before: 5-minute ORB on US100, noise-area breakout, Gao last-half-hour momentum, overnight-intraday reversal: not repeated

tests.J1 08:30 ET release continuation (PRIMAR: news day if |return 08:30-08:35 ET| > 4x the median |08:30-08:35 return| of the previous 60 sessions; enter at 08:35 in the direction of that move, exit 10:00 ET; size 1 (ES and NQ, 0.5 each)
tests.J2 14:00 ET release continuation (FOMC,: same detection on 14:00-14:05 ET; enter 14:05, exit 15:55 ET
tests.J3 RTH opening-gap fade: gap = 09:30 ET open / previous 16:00 ET close - 1; if |gap| > 0.4%: fade at 09:30 (short after up-gaps, long after down-gaps); exit when price touches the previous close, at a stop of one gap size beyond the 09:30 open, or at 11:00 ET at the latest; stop/target checked on 1-minute high/low (stop first if both in one minute)

costs: futures: 1 tick + $0.85 per side on micros (MES/MNQ), as futures_db.cost_frac; a stop exit costs one extra tick. CFD replication: 1 bp per side
rule: futures stand-alone: DEV > 0, TEST >= 0.5, HOLD >= 0.3; AND the same rule on the CFD replication must not be negative over TEST+HOLD combined. Prop fit: all three are flat by 16:00 ET (Topstep/Lucid compatible)
